rationale: DKNG has gapped down ~26% on an earnings miss, creating an extremely wide and chaotic opening range with the last two 1-minute candles showing violent swings (high of $17.84 to low of $16.80). Price is sitting at 13% of today's range, near the session low, with the last print below VWAP and the 9-EMA — but the earnings-driven gap-down with a significant EPS miss creates unpredictable mean-reversion vs. continuation dynamics that are difficult to edge. The spread and volatility are manageable, but the lack of a clear directional setup with price bouncing erratically in the lower portion of a massive gap makes this a low-confidence environment where skipping preserves capital.
